system.description:
The rarest pact — granted only when he sees something worth possessing.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Once per day, force one creature within 60ft to answer one question truthfully unless it beats a Will save against your Class Save DC. A creature that fails this save also suffers disadvantage on its next attack roll or save.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, learn the name, face, and one significant secret of any creature you have made any formal agreement with, no matter how minor. Asmodeus catalogues everything.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, issue a Geas with no saving throw against a creature of Level up to half your level.
